notes.title: DEVLOG #6: COSMIC FEAR - PROGRESS UPDATE
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Welcome back to another devlog for my upcoming game, Cosmic Fear. I’m thrilled to share some exciting updates on the progress as I continue to bring this Lovecraftian horror adventure to life. 

[previewyoutube=8QND2UhKSoU;full][/previewyoutube]
I've been crafting new environments that will take you deeper into the unknown. 
The latest environments are inspired by some of the eeriest corners of the universe, blending Lovecraftian horror with breathtakingly beautiful yet haunting landscapes. I’m paying close attention to every detail, from the creepy soundscapes to the dynamic lighting effects, to ensure that each environment feels unique and contributes to the overall atmosphere of dread.

Here's a sneak peek at what I’ve been working on:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/c7e2f639436fc6c16665871734d04471c7f1098a.jpg
I’m excited for you to explore these new areas and uncover the secrets they hold.


In addition to the world building, I’m also working on the save system:


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/95a12baf238c0f385012891dbc0557980ffb4091.jpg

Join me on Youtube!

I’m often live on my Youtube channel where you can join me while I play games, as well as dive deep into game development discussions, share tips and tricks, and interact with you. It's a great way to stay connected, and I can't wait to see you there and chat with you all in real-time! 


Don't forget to grab the Cosmic Horror bundle on sale!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/23128/Cosmic_Horror_Bundle/

Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm!

notes.title: COSMIC FEAR Announced! Wishlist now!
notes.content:
Exciting news, everyone! 
I'm thrilled to announce that the Steam page for my new game, COSMIC FEAR, is now live! 
Make sure to WISHLIST the game and help grow our community by sharing this exciting news.

COSMIC FEAR - WISHLIST NOW!

Plot: 
Cosmic Fear is a disturbing Lovecraftian horror adventure where you find yourself investigating on strange phenomena that occur in a nearby forest. This time the episodes are weirder than usual and it looks like you're not the only one who's keeping an eye on them. 

[previewyoutube=8QND2UhKSoU;full][/previewyoutube]

As a solo developer, this is a massive project that I've been working on for years after my second title The Alien Cube. 
I've transitioned from CryEngine to Unreal Engine 5, using the latest technologies to deliver cutting-edge graphics, an immersive atmosphere, and a deep, engaging story. 
Cosmic Fear expands the narrative of The Land of Pain and The Alien Cube, introducing significant improvements and a broader, more immersive experience. 
The way the Lovecraftian theme was brought to life in my previous games was much appreciated, and with Cosmic Fear I'm confident this new adventure will captivate you even more. The dread and wonder of Lovecraft's universe will be more intense than ever. Each step you take will pull you further into the chilling depths of this cosmic horror experience. 

Help me reach more people! Every single share is crucial, and any help is greatly appreciated. 
I've also set up a newsletter on my website where you can sign up to receive the latest news and you’ll also have a chance to join the beta testing program. 

Thank you all for your amazing support!

notes.title: Lovecraftian Days and game development showcase!
notes.content:
Dear fellow cosmic horror enthusiasts, I’m thrilled to announce you that the Lovecraftian Days are here!
During this otherworldly event I will stream a timelapse video about my upcoming game, with behind-the-scenes glimpses into the game's creation. 

Q&A
During the livestream I will be available to answer your questions and talk about the development. Feel free to talk with with me in the broadcast chat!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/8af4cce7d7db31bc58478531e355ee58ef5b54e6.jpg
Unreal Engine 5
I am developing the game with Unreal Engine 5, that allows to reach next-gen graphics through cutting-edge features such as: 
- Lumen Global Illumination: dynamic lighting that adapts to your every move, creating stunningly realistic scenes.
- Nanite Virtualized Geometry: a  system which allows to obtain an incredible level of detail for every object in the game. Nanite  to obtain an incredible level of detail without sacrificing performance.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/8b353054f57aa452ea9aed4ef4b9bb2902a83bf4.jpg
About my new game
This is going to be a cosmic-horror game focused on story and mystery, with realistic graphics and an immersive atmosphere.
In this chilling adventure you will have to face the inevitability of fate while exploring disturbing places, finding clues and studying ancient mysteries. 
Like my previous games, The Land of Pain and The Alien Cube, the game is inspired by Lovecraftian literature.

🔮 Why Lovecraft?
H.P. Lovecraft's cosmic horror legacy continues to captivate and terrify. His influence echoes through the ages, inspiring authors, artists and game developers from all over the world. Lovecraft’s macabre imagination has been inspiring for my works too, in particular his ability to place emphasis on the terror of the unknowable and incomprehensible.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/3fe9069448ed1c43d98492cf130e6b3462c36245.jpg
Stay Tuned
Follow our social media channels for updates, teasers and exclusive content. 
Last but not least, the Cosmic Horror Bundle will be on sale for the entire duration if the event!

notes.title: DEVLOG #2 - New game update
notes.content:
Hi everyone, I hope you had a great 2024 start!

Here’s a quick update on the new game I’m working on, a first person horror adventure with Lovecraftian lore and extraterrestrial vibes. 

I’m currently working on a new map, an abandoned village which seems to be connected to an ancient legend around a factory not far from there. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/29d6bb961cfa9ef661485c2632c5d23d587cb009.jpg
Plot: You are a young archeology student and decide to spend a few weeks at your grandparents’ home to study for the exams. One day you find yourself investigating strange phenomena that occur only at a certain time of the year in a nearby forest. This time the episodes are weirder than usual and it looks like you're not the only one who's keeping an eye on them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/7a94a8719cd85cb3a60c73931b06b085d9005ebc.jpg
You'll explore different environments such as sinister forests, abandoned buildings and underground tunnels, where antique secrets will come to light after being buried for centuries.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/f2cba8c1224e38c33a15b7a029f72db61d17da07.jpg

Like The Alien Cube and The Land of Pain, this is going to be a cosmic-horror game focused on story and mystery, with realistic graphics and an immersive atmosphere.
In this chilling adventure you will have to face the inevitability of fate while exploring disturbing places, finding clues and studying ancient mysteries.

To be up-to-date with the latest news follow me on my socials and on my Steam developer page.

Also, don’t forget that The Land of Pain and The Alien Cube are on sale right now!

notes.title: Devlog - Updates on my third project
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 
here I am with some news on my next game! After The Alien Cube and The Land of Pain I am now working on my third game, a first person horror adventure with Lovecraftian lore and extraterrestrial vibes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/e00e9a387f903bcef25a365f51f3b5bffd701b71.jpg
The level design

To realize my project I am using Unreal Engine 5 and its latest technologies such as Nanite and Lumen.

Nanite is a virtualized geometry system which allows to obtain an incredible level of detail for every object in the game.

Lumen is a dynamic global illumination and reflections system that allows for very accurate and realistic lighting. Both technologies help developers reaching the best results in terms of graphics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/dc33e5a7f171af3cd1bdf71dd3630048afddfd33.jpg
In this moment I am building big natural environments that the player will be able to explore while trying to unveil the mysteries that surround the place. There will be also interiors and disturbing underground structures to discover, where ancient secrets will come to light after being buried for years.

The story

The protagonist, a university student keen on ancient mysteries, is investigating strange phenomena that occur only at a certain time of the year in a nearby forest. This time the episodes are weirder than usual and it looks like someone else is keeping an eye on them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/f580275fbccb7428b94251b38b8fc8c04e565be5.jpg
PS: tomorrow it's The Land of Pain's 6th anniversary and to celebrate this event all my games are on sale!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/23128/Cosmic_Horror_Bundle/

To be up-to-date with the latest news on my upcoming game follow me on TWITTER , INSTAGRAM and my STEAM DEVELOPER PAGE!

-Alessandro

notes.title: LOVECRAFT EVENT & NEW GAME REVEAL
notes.content:
The Lovecraft Tag event on Steam has just begun! 
To celebrate this special moment, the game has been updated with an in-game event as a tribute to the most important source of inspiration for my games: H.P. Lovecraft.
He was a writer of horror and weird stories, born in Providence in 1890.
He is mostly known for the creation of the Cthulhu Mythos. In his tales he made frequent references to ancient and powerful gods called the "Great Old Ones". 
Lovecraft’s macabre imagination has been inspiring for my works, in particular his ability to convey a feeling of insignificance that characterizes man's place in the universe. His protagonists have to deal with a horrifying truth that should not be revealed to humanity.

THE INGAME EVENT:
It consists in a new main menu theme and a secret drawing that I’ve hidden somewhere in the game. Search everywhere and find it!
This event will last one month.

GAME UPDATE:
The game has also been updated with bug fixes and general improvements.

MY NEXT PROJECT:
Are you curious to see something about my next game? Here are a few sneak peeks for you:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/f580275fbccb7428b94251b38b8fc8c04e565be5.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/4ff2c8a8c99ba8b8fabfb7cef36f626a6d33baeb.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35841416/eb1f99b6c6e3958d0f754784d61549e0cefb83bb.jpg

Those scenarios are in very early stages as I’m currently developing them, so keep in mind that they are not representing the final quality of the game. 
Leave a comment and let me know what you think! ;)
Like my previous games, it is a first person horror adventure with a strong focus on Lovecraftian vibes. It’s a very ambitious project and I can’t wait to share with you a lot more in the next future!

HELP ME GROWING THE COMMUNITY:
As a solo dev, it would be amazing for me if you could help me growing the community around my games by following my Steam Developer Page and my socials: 

STEAM DEVELOPER PAGE
TWITTER
INSTAGRAM

A big thank to everyone!
-Alessandro

notes.title: Play the Demo at the Steam Game Festival!
notes.content:
About The Alien Cube:
A disturbing reality is about to be unveiled, something that mankind should never know. After a mysterious finding, unexplainable facts occur and strange happenings will lead you to doubt the world around you. Uncover an otherworldly secret and explore forbidden places to find out the truth. 
Main Features
SURVIVE -- Wander in snowy forests, face hostile weather conditions and travel through otherworldly places and creepy dungeons.
LOVECRAFTIAN HORROR -- Experience an atmosphere of decay and terror, trying to delve into an incomprehensible reality.
EXPLORE & INTERACT -- Discover horrifying places, find items to solve puzzles and seek out clues to help unravel the mystery.
BEAUTIFUL VISUALS -- CryEngine 5-powered graphics with photogrammetric technology allows powerful visuals.
IMMERSIVE AUDIO -- An atmospheric soundtrack and high quality ambient sounds will give you a true horror experience.
THE LAND OF PAIN -- Investigate your uncle, the protagonist of the game The Land of Pain. Discover the truth about his past and find how these two games are connected.

Download the demo now!
What are you waiting for? The demo is already available, download it on the game's page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1099220/The_Alien_Cube/

Check out the prequel!
The Alien Cube will be released in spring 2021. While you’re waiting for the release, play previous game: The Land of Pain! It is now 50% off, so don’t miss this chance!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/568930/The_Land_of_Pain/
